title: The shared responsibility model: what is yours and what is the provider’s

videos.script: Keeping a cloud safe is work you share with your provider. {{line}} The cloud course drew it as one line across a stack. Below the line, the provider does the work. Above it, you do. {{evidence}} This lesson gives the line a second meaning. It also splits the evidence. {{report}} Below it, all you can do is read what an auditor wrote. {{api}} Above it, you can ask the API, and the answer is about your own account, today. {{bucket}} So you will ask a new bucket four questions, set four answers, and ask again. {{breaks}} Then you will look at where incidents start. Mostly above the line. Sometimes below it, where all you can do is notice. {{fate}} And you will see how providers now help with your half: by deciding for you, unless you decide otherwise. {{end}}
